title: Degrading quality
body:
Google runs some of the most complicated software in the world and somehow this apps quality has gone down significantly 
I always relied on this app to help me remember quick tasks, for the past year it’s become a nightmare. First you insisted I download tasks… I went with it… now even when tied to tasks I still don’t get reminders
Now what has caused me to write this review is because for some reason copy pasting and selecting have become nearly impossible… on a notes app??? WTH is going on? I thought it was just my phone, I tried it on a colleagues and the same issue is there. I’m really trying not to delete this app because of how long I’ve used it. I have notes all the way from 2016 but if this doesn’t change soon I’ll be forced to migrate to something more reliable. Pls fix. Thnx.
author: DukeRollo

title: Exceptional
body: Google keep is one app I’ve never regretted. My poetry is orderly, neat and save. Good work developers. On the flip side, I don’t like people snooping on my raw writings, i would love an update with a security feature on it; something like pin, passcode or fingerprint to launch the app. Fantastic
